instruction: Rewrite this government notice in plain English for citizens, in at most two short sentences. Keep every fact.
context: Citizens seeking driving licence renewal are required to utilise the NovaDrive portal; the fee of NCD 300 is non-refundable.
response: Apply for driving licence renewal on the NovaDrive portal. The NCD 300 fee is not refundable.

instruction: Rewrite this government notice in plain English for citizens, in at most two short sentences. Keep every fact.
context: The trade licence renewal service is accessible solely through the Nova Business portal; incomplete applications or those lacking the NCD 1200 fee shall not be processed.
response: Only the Nova Business portal handles trade licence renewal. Applications that are incomplete or unpaid (NCD 1200) are not processed.
